# Kingsley Ukeje

> Official website of Kingsley Ukeje — UX Engineer and Principal Product Designer.

Building digital products and design systems across fintech, SaaS, and emerging technology.

## About

Kingsley Ukeje is a product designer and UX engineer with experience designing and building products for startups and high-growth technology companies, including Eze (YC W20), Carrot, Hotels.ng, and Space.

Areas of expertise:
- Product Design
- UX Engineering
- Design Systems
- Frontend Development
- AI Product Design
